Chiang Mai Old City

Walk at dawn. Wat Phra Singh, Chedi Luang, and the city gates are the circuit. Midday is for a cafe or a nap.

ShapeA square moat you can walk in an hour
MarketSunday Walking Street on Ratchadamnoen
StayGuesthouses and a few quiet hotels

Scooters cut the corners. Sidewalks vanish. The moat road is the easy loop if you are tired of sois.

Common questions

Is the Old City quiet at night?
The inner lanes are. The east gates pick up bars. Nimman is louder and later.
